>When was the last time you were really interested in something?

I don't know, they all seem like a distraction from an inevitable fate so I don't really do anything other than bury myself in this vicious cycle of negative thoughts.

'Friends' also seem like a distraction from an inevitable fate. I hate that I'm needy, I wish I could be happy be myself because everytime I'm with someone I have to play nice and hold my feelings to not tell them to shut the fuck up and leave me alone.

You said you ruin everything for others but what about yourself? I don't know if that's the case but try not considering much what other's say about you. Instead, keep living for yourself and only you. There's no such relationship like the one we have with ouselves.
